WHAT WE DO

Four programs.
One watershed.

01 / MEASURE

Water Quality Monitoring

Volunteers collect samples at 62 fixed sites every month, year-round. The proposed public database and regulatory filings connect observation to action.

CONCEPT PROGRAM / NO LIVE WATER QUALITY FEED

02 / REPAIR

Streambank Restoration

Native plantings and engineered log structures can stabilise eroding banks, hold sediment and support cooler water. The concept records 86 projects since 2004.

03 / DEFEND

Advocacy & Permits

Review discharge permit applications and comment on the ones that matter. This is a proposed programme, not legal representation or a regulatory service.

04 / PASS IT ON

Watershed Education

A proposed 4,000-student annual field programme, alongside landowner workshops on buffers and septic maintenance. Learn how a watershed connects us.
